title: Conformity
body_md: The manufacturer declares that the product complies with the essential requirements and the relevant provisions of Directive 2014/53/EU. For the detailed declaration of conformity the source points to a download; the address is not reproduced here.
prev_context: Before this stand the disposal instructions.
next_context: The section on technical support follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 25: both versions name the **same** directive, 2014/53/EU. For the generation up to SN-044 a non-existent directive is on record in the English part at this very point (DSC-071); the error does not occur in this generation. The download address differs between the versions and is not carried over in any form (BLK-004).
